parts.t: Welcome to Azure West, a luxurious townhouse in an ideal location! This beautifully maintained craftsman-style 4-bed, 4-bath home offers 2,744 sqft of living space on three levels. It features a grand 19' vaulted great room, a gourmet kitchen with new stainless appliances, and newer carpets throughout. The upper level includes a master bedroom, a study/office, and two additional bedrooms, all with newly RENOVATED bathrooms. The fully finished basement provides an extra bedroom and a RENOVATED bathroom. Enjoy outdoor entertaining with a gas BBQ hook-up. An EV CHARGER adds a modern touch. The pet-friendly complex is tucked away from traffic yet close to shops, services, transit, schools, and restaurants in Morgan Crossing.
